coaching.headline: A one-sided win: Drongo's 15 kills and a personal kill on all five enemies anchored nine fights won, kills 31-3.
coaching.team: We won nine of ten fights and turned the 18.8 swing into Orb Prime and an Inhibitor. The 16.5 Fangtooth fight was the mistake: Feng Mao was dead and Xeebs was across map, so we started 4v5. Feng still dealt 20,283 objective damage (second on the team); one bad death doesn’t erase that pressure. Next game: if your jungler is dead before Fangtooth, trade across map or reset—don’t start the 4v5.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 18.8 teamfight, won 4-0 right after the shaky 16.5 fight where the team was down a body, turned the game for good — every fight after it went our way, including the Orb Prime and Inhibitor takes.
coaching.whatWorked: The duo lane closed the game early: first blood at 7.7, zero deaths before minute ten, and the first Fangtooth, all ours.

perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Drongo led the win: 15/1/7, team-high 41,442 hero damage, and a kill on all five opponents. The feed confirms fight impact; it can’t prove he attended every fight.
perPlayer.f07cd656-a40d-4000-a289-c7f9f8dd50f9: Steel shut the offlane down alone, killing Shinbi five separate times across the match, and he finished zero deaths in 31 minutes while mitigating a team-high 66,420 damage — the frontline job the comp needed.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Adele did the support job cleanly. First blood on Lt. Belica at 7.7 in the duo lane, zero deaths before minute ten, and a team-high 20 wards placed against the enemy support's 18 backed a 55% kill-participation night. The lane model called this matchup unfavored the whole game; the duo lane and the box score both disagreed.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Renna put up the third-highest damage on the team, 28,833, and finished 5 kills to 1 death. But a solo catch by Lt. Belica at 18.1 handed over the Outer Tower before the team could avenge it 4-0 minutes later.
perPlayer.2dc38586-23d0-4b5a-8e3c-0c4bdf03e1cc: Feng Mao dealt 20,283 objective damage, second on the team. He died alone before the 16.5 Fangtooth fight; the team then lost the fight and objective. Fix the timing around the objective, but don’t erase the pressure he built all game.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Drongo ran the full winning core, Lightning Hawk, Vanquisher and Tainted Rounds, then added Imperator and Demolisher for pure late-game execute power — on core, nothing to teach here.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Vermis's on-hit max-health damage on every third basic fits Drongo's kite-and-shoot marksman combo, trading away Demiurge's item-scaling burst for the consistent DPS that carried the extended fights Drongo dominated tonight.

f07cd656-a40d-4000-a289-c7f9f8dd50f9.build: Steel skipped the entire winning core (Fire Blossom, Tainted Guard, Flux Matrix) for Crystalline Cuirass, Dynamo, Golem's Gift and Tainted Charm — the anti-heal still landed via Tainted Charm instead of Tainted Guard, and the team-high 66,420 mitigated says the swap worked fine tonight.
f07cd656-a40d-4000-a289-c7f9f8dd50f9.eternal: Vesh's ability-damage DoT fits Steel's hybrid engage kit, and the zero-death, five-kills-on-Shinbi night never needed Krix's flat health scaling instead.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Adele skipped two of the winning core's three items, Dawnstar and Raiment of Renewal, for Dynamo, Frosted Lure, Inquisition and Fire Blossom instead — nothing in tonight's zero-death, first-blood game shows the swap cost anything.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: The engine doesn't model support Eternals for Adele — Exarch, Aion, Lotus, Marrow, Nihil, Weald, Pilow and Satariel are all unmodeled, so there's no graded fit read here.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Renna ran the full winning core, Entropy, Wraith Leggings and Overseer, then added Oblivion Crown for more magical power on top — on core, nothing to teach here.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: Vesh's ability-damage DoT fits Renna's zone-and-chunk mage kit, rewarding the ability spam that put up 28,833 damage to heroes tonight over Demiurge's item-scaling burst.

2dc38586-23d0-4b5a-8e3c-0c4bdf03e1cc.build: Feng Mao skipped two of the winning core's three items, Painweaver and Omen, for Vyzar Carapace, Nightfall and Transference — a sustain trade that still didn't stop the solo catch by Mourn at 16 that cost the Fangtooth.
2dc38586-23d0-4b5a-8e3c-0c4bdf03e1cc.eternal: Vermis's on-hit max-health damage fits Feng Mao's basic-attack duelist combo, trading Demiurge's item-scaling burst for the sustained pressure his execute kit wants in extended trades.

focus.title: Don’t split the 4v5 from the cross-map trade.
focus.evidence: At 16.5 Feng Mao was dead before the Fangtooth fight. We still took Mini Prime while they secured Fangtooth, so the team split its pressure between a losing contest and the trade.
focus.action: When one side is already trading, call the give-and-take before the fight: yield Fangtooth and commit to Mini Prime, or reset for a later contest. Don’t split the team.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s), Mourn Abduct (pull). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Mourn. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

enemyKits.passive: Rising Storm stacks grant attack speed
enemyKits.playWith: a team that lets her side-lane and pick
enemyKits.playAgainst: she wants 1v1s — group and burst her; Quelling Gale only stops projectiles

enemyKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
enemyKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling

enemyKits.combo: Abduct pull → Contagion ally-heal bugs → Beguile damage-reduction → Eclipse vision-denial ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and sustain the team through the brawl
enemyKits.playWith: burst that punishes his pulled target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect the long Abduct channel/range; anti-heal blunts Contagion

enemyKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult

adele.loadout: Idrisil (Cold Hearted + Icy Touch), augment Court of Roses, crest Leafsong
lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Never died in 31 minutes, fewer deaths than about 98% of Adele support players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage.
Queen’s Garden at rank 3: 80s base, about 57.1s by the end (29% shorter) from 40 ability haste: Dynamo 10, Frosted Lure 10, Xenia 10, Inquisition 10.
Adele dealt 14,545 hero damage, 11% of their team's, with +0 physical power from items.
Dynamo (item): On Immobilizing an Enemy: They take 8% more damage for 2.5s.
Frosted Lure (item): On being near Enemy Heroes for 4s: Deal 80 (+4%) Damage to nearby Heroes. Slows by 40% for 1.5s. Shields you for 150% of the damage dealt for 4s.
Inquisition (item): On Ability Cast: Emit a wave of energy. Deals 65 (+1.5%) Damage to Enemies in the area. Damage is increased by 45% against Monsters.
Fire Blossom (item): Burn nearby Enemy Units: Deals 15 (+1%) Damage each second.Firestorm - When Heatwave damages a Target: Deals 5% more damage each second, up to 40%.
Court of Roses (augment): Iron Rose grants nearest Ally a 5s barrier with 20% Damage Reduction and attaches Thorned Vines to nearby Enemy Heroes dealing 50% damage.

Sustain: Frosted Lure: On being near Enemy Heroes for 4s: Deal 80 (+4%) Damage to nearby Heroes. Slows by 40% for 1.5s. Shields you for 150% of the damage dealt for 4s.; Xenia: When within 200u to an Ally Hero: Grant them a 50 (+10%)(+5 per Level) Shield for 4s. Cooldown is per Target.; 3,199 healing recorded.
Toughness: +1570 health, +150 physical armor, +65 magical armor; took 27,129 damage, mitigated 37,495, died 0 times.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Cold Hearted, Icy Touch.
The Eternal was part of it: Idrisil (Cold Hearted + Icy Touch) sits on the same trigger as the items (every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 1 of the 3 players Adele killed built physical armor (Mourn). We killed Adele 0 times.
Copy it? Idrisil: 52.7% in 484 Adele support games, above the hero's 49.4%. Proven this patch: worth copying.

card.lesson: Queen’s Garden came back about every 57s instead of 80s by the end (29% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.

lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 1 time in 31 minutes, fewer deaths than about 98% of Drongo carry players this patch. The build added healing off damage.
Drongo dealt 41,442 hero damage, 32% of their team's, with +262 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12, Demolisher ignores 25%; against Revenant (level 16: about 104 physical armor, 66 after penetration; took 13,207 physical damage from heroes, 59% of all hero damage they took) and Mourn (level 13: about 152 physical armor, 102 after penetration; took 15,385 physical damage from heroes, 62% of all hero damage they took) that is about 23% and 25% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Pacifier (crest): Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health.
Weald (Eternal): Damaging an Enemy Hero below 30% Health fires 4 (+1 per 30% Bonus Attack Speed) projectiles that each deal 7 (+1 per level) True Damage.

Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.; Taproot: Basic Attacks restore 1 (+6% Bonus Physical Power) Health on-hit. Does not heal from Tower damage.; 7,238 healing recorded.

Lesson: Drongo's penetration cut through: Revenant took about 23% more physical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 16 their armor was about 104, about 66 after 12 flat + 25% penetration).
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 5 effects on one trigger: Lightning Hawk, Tainted Rounds, Demolisher, Weald, Taproot.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 3 effects on one trigger: Tainted Rounds, Pacifier, Taproot.
Stack (Finishing damage on low-health targets): 2 effects on one trigger: Vanquisher, Weald. Once a fight started going their way, these finished it.

The Eternal was part of it: Weald (Forage + Taproot) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; healing off the damage; finishing damage on low-health targets), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 1 of the 5 players Drongo killed built physical armor (Mourn). Anti-heal on Yin, Shinbi. We killed Drongo 1 time.
